text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: The cherry blossoms are in full bloom for this year's Oka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Who will win the tiara today? Only time will tell!

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text: Hishi Amazon… She ran in the Hanshin J.F., right?

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text: Apparently. I heard she's a strong contender for the Triple Tiara this year.
There's quite a number of spectators in the stands who are looking forward to seeing Hishi Amazon race.
Meanwhile, Hishi Amazon herself is a little distracted.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Ack! Sorry about that. I just zoned out for a second!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Well… Don't laugh at what I'm about to tell you, okay?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I know I chose the Tiara to prove I was worthy of challenging Brian and all, but…

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Now that I've come all this way, it feels like… I'unno.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I kinda feel like I was meant for this path—that this is the start of a whole new me.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Man, what am I even saying?! Forget all of that!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: I've gotta focus on winning this first! Here I go, full steam ahead!
Hishi Amazon heads into the Oka Sho with a wide, courageous grin!
